name: Trancoso
blurb: Trancoso is located on the south coast of Bahia, featuring a historic old fishing village called the Quadrado full of shops and restaurants. Visitors note it is a tiny town caught between the jungle and the sea, accessible via Porto Seguro.

positive: Enjoyable beach walks and outdoor activities like ATV riding
Great vibe and music at local spots like Muro bar in the Quadrado
Sightings of local wildlife such as monkeys and sloths
negative: Mention of political commentary criticizing social media posts in beach clubs
